entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP authentication failure message received by the UE, which may be contained within an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message that may contain EAP-failure and triggers authentication failure handling procedures.

entities.name: UE EAP-failure handling procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE upon receiving EAP-failure message, involving security context deletion, state transitions, and counter management.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Temporary security context created during authentication that gets deleted upon EAP-failure.

entities.name: KAUSF and KSEAF keys
entities.description: Authentication and security anchor function keys that are deleted if created during the authentication procedure.

entities.name: Update status 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
entities.description: Registration status indicating roaming is not allowed, set when authentication fails.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: UE state entered after authentication failure, where UE searches for available PLMNs/SNPNs.

entities.name: USIM considered invalid condition
entities.description: Condition where USIM is considered invalid until UE is switched off or UICC is removed, triggered by authentication failure.

entities.name: Counter set to maximum value condition
entities.description: Condition where various service invalidity counters are set to UE implementation-specific maximum values.

entities.name: Timers T3510, T3517, T3519, T3521
entities.description: NAS timers that are stopped when AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received.

entities.name: Stored SUCI
entities.description: Subscription Concealed Identifier that gets deleted upon authentication failure.

relations.description: UE EAP-failure handling procedure is triggered by receiving EAP-failure message.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message may contain EAP-failure message.
Procedure deletes the partial native 5G NAS security context.
Procedure deletes KAUSF and KSEAF keys if they were created.
Procedure sets update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED.
Procedure causes UE to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state.
Procedure establishes condition where USIM is considered invalid.
Procedure sets various service invalidity counters to maximum values.
Procedure stops timers T3510, T3517, T3519, T3521 if running.
